summary: Implement one bounded work unit with requirement-linked evidence and a reviewable change set.

inputs.name: work-plan
inputs.description: A ready work item, dependencies, ownership, and verification requirements.

inputs.name: specification
inputs.description: Authoritative behavior and acceptance criteria for the item.

inputs.name: diagnosis
inputs.description: Established cause and reproduction for a defect fix.

completion_checks: The selected work item is implemented without unrelated changes.
Behavioral evidence is tied to the resulting candidate.
Known limitations and verification gaps are disclosed.
failure_modes: A prerequisite or required execution environment is missing: blocked.
Observed behavior contradicts acceptance criteria: failed.
A bounded implementation attempt cannot establish correctness: inconclusive.
